prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func UniqueSortedSquares(input string) (string, bool)
Behavior: Parse a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed decimal integers in -1000..1000. Square every value, remove duplicates, sort increasing, and return comma-separated decimal values. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: -3,2,3,0,-2 returns 0,4,9.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
